headline: Sign This
caption:
UPDATE: Sean Strickland says the UFC made him sign before it gave him the title shot.
Fair or not? 👇

MMA Junkie's Mike Bohn reports the middleweight champ signed a six-fight UFC deal before UFC 328, paying over $1M a fight. Strickland replied on X that it was "sign this or we won't do this." UFC news.

Who's right here?
question: Fair or not?

v2.story: Strickland says the UFC tied his title shot to signing a new six-fight deal.
v2.question: Fair or not?
